_comment: How the hosted copy of this dashboard is protected. See src/deployment.js.
_options: google = the app checks Google sign-in itself (needs 4 environment variables). gateway = Vercel's own password/team protection guards the door before a request reaches the app (needs none).
_warning: Only set this to gateway as part of a deploy where the protection is already switched on and verified. Committing gateway with no protection in front of it would serve the data to anyone. google is the fail-closed default and stays here until then.
